overview: Ceramics Terrace is home to Katta’s pottery artisans, producing household goods, ceremonial vessels, and arcane‑reinforced ceramics.
history: Founded to centralize pottery and kiln‑craft production.
Guild oversight ensured safe kiln operation and glazing standards.
Arcane kilnwrights introduced resonance‑heat firing for reinforced ceramics.
The district expanded to support Artisan Row and Tailors Walk.
hooks: A ceremonial vessel order for the Senate is behind schedule.
A kiln overheats, threatening a chain reaction.
A rare clay shipment goes missing from the storage yard.
Arcane glazing tools malfunction across the district.
